== Introduction ==

Jim may have had the toughest weekend of all '99 Star Wars CCG World Finalists. He began play in the DecipherCon WildCard tournament early Thursday. The day was exhausting - his 2nd place finish in the 160+ player WildCard wasn't secured until 1am Friday morning. After a few hours sleep, Jim, a 1998 Star Wars World Finalist, brought his decks to the World preliminary rounds and nabbed a Top 12 finish to advance to the Semi-finals. Saturday, his third straight day of Finals play, he was in contention for a place in the Final Confrontation until his fourth and final game, a loss to eventual World Champion Gary Carman. Jim's two Semi-finals wins [4(+11)] won him 4th place overall. A great effort over a loooong weekend!

Jim's game results Day 2:

Game 1 (DS): W (21) - Martin Akesson

Game 2 (LS): W (21) - Bastian Winkelhaus

Game 3 (LS): L (-11) - Yannick Lapointe

Game 4 (DS): W (-20) - Gary Carman
